detections.summary: Hosts recount how a boy, Walter Zapeta, denied food and water for days during a religious exorcism ritual, died of dehydration.

detections.evidence_quote: you just killed a little boy
detections.summary: Hosts note the perpetrators showed no remorse over Walter's death, believing it returned him to Jesus, and condemn this as having killed a child.
Hosts recount the 2003 case of an 8-year-old autistic boy, Terrance Cotrell, who died when his congregation attempted to heal his autism through a restraint-based exorcism ritual.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Prayer and exorcism can heal or cure autism.
verification_candidates.rationale: Reported claim that exorcism/prayer could cure autism, directly relevant to the child's death being recounted; checkable against evidence on autism etiology and treatment.
